```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                       fig.align = "center", fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4)

if (!exists("project_folder")) {
  project_folder <- getwd()
  pipeline_folder <- getwd()
  features_file <- "config/features.yaml"
  sample_file <- "config/samples.tsv"
}

source(file.path(pipeline_folder, "workflow", "scripts", "R", "report_helpers.R"))
samples <- read.delim(file.path(project_folder, sample_file), comment.char = "#")
features <- yaml::read_yaml(file.path(project_folder, features_file))
ra_dir <- file.path(project_folder, "results", "read_annotate")
```

# Kraken2 taxonomic classification

```{r kraken2-summary}
kraken_dbs <- names(features$databases$kraken2)
kraken_dir <- file.path(ra_dir, "kraken2")

top_taxa <- purrr::map_dfr(kraken_dbs, function(db) {
  purrr::pmap_dfr(samples[, c("sample_id", "library_id")], function(sample_id, library_id) {
    f <- file.path(kraken_dir, db, paste0(sample_id, ".", library_id, ".report"))
    df <- parse_kraken2_report(f, top_n = 5)
    if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
    dplyr::bind_cols(database = db, library = paste(sample_id, library_id, sep = "."), df)
  })
})

if (nrow(top_taxa) == 0) {
  cat("_No kraken2 output found yet._\n")
} else {
  preview_table(
    top_taxa[, c("database", "library", "name", "rank", "pct", "reads_clade")],
    n = min(30, nrow(top_taxa)),
    caption = "Top 5 taxa by clade percentage, per library and database"
  )
}
```

# Sequence diversity / coverage (Nonpareil)

```{r nonpareil-summary}
nonpareil_tsv <- file.path(ra_dir, "nonpareil", "nonpareil.tsv")
preview_table(safe_read_tsv(nonpareil_tsv), n = 50, caption = "Nonpareil diversity/coverage estimates per sample")
```

# Marker-gene taxonomic profiling (SingleM)

```{r singlem-summary}
mf_tsv <- file.path(ra_dir, "singlem", "microbial_fraction.tsv")
mf_df <- safe_read_tsv(mf_tsv)
if (nrow(mf_df) > 0) {
  preview_table(mf_df, n = nrow(mf_df), caption = "SingleM microbial fraction per library")
} else {
  cat("_No SingleM microbial_fraction output found yet._\n")
}
```

# Functional profiling (HUMAnN)

```{r humann-summary}
humann_top <- parse_humann_top_features(file.path(ra_dir, "humann", "humann_genefamilies.tsv"))
if (nrow(humann_top) == 0) {
  cat("_No HUMAnN output found yet._\n")
} else {
  preview_table(humann_top[, 1:2], n = nrow(humann_top),
                caption = "Top gene families by total abundance across samples (UNMAPPED/UNGROUPED excluded)")
}
```

# Taxonomic profiling (MetaPhlAn)

```{r metaphlan-summary}
metaphlan_top <- parse_metaphlan_top_taxa(file.path(ra_dir, "metaphlan", "metaphlan_profiled.tsv"))
if (nrow(metaphlan_top) == 0) {
  cat("_No MetaPhlAn output found yet._\n")
} else {
  preview_table(metaphlan_top[, 1:2], n = nrow(metaphlan_top),
                caption = "Top species by mean relative abundance across samples")
}
```

```{r metaphlan-plot, fig.height=4}
if (nrow(metaphlan_top) > 0) {
  ggplot(metaphlan_top, aes(x = reorder(species, mean_abundance), y = mean_abundance)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#7F3F98") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(title = "Top species by mean relative abundance", x = NULL, y = "Mean relative abundance (%)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
}
```
